'''Carto ''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] agent of the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he was stationed on the [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Agent Carto first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]''.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1st}}
